name: Developer Entity Browser
description: A single admin report that lists every content entity type, its bundles, and each bundle's fields (types, descriptions, cardinality, allowed values and reference target bundles).
project_description:
The Developer Entity Browser module is designed to enhance developer efficiency by providing a unified interface for comprehensive oversight of all content entities and entity bundles. It enables developers to seamlessly navigate through entities, aggregate field names, and review configuration settings, all from a single, intuitive dashboard.

 Features 
 Quick access to your custom entities entity types, bundles and field architecture. 

 Post-Installation 
 Allow permissions to the report by first going to your Permission page and allowing access to View Dev Entity Browser.

You'll then find the report from the Reports drop-down.

 Similar projects 
 Devel allows you to get a deeper understanding of fields and entities.
